observations: Photos show at least two orange LPG gas cylinders (foreign-used style) stored indoors against a wall.
Cylinder valves/regulators are visible on the front cylinder(s) in photo 0 and photo 1.
The cylinders show wear/scuffs/dents and paint fading (photo 0, photo 1, photo 2).
Photo 2 shows a label/markings on the cylinder body, but the exact brand/model and the 12.5kg marking are not clearly readable.
No clear photo shows the cylinder weight rating (12.5kg) or the tare/serial details sharply enough to confirm.

claims.evidence: The 12.5kg marking is not clearly readable in photo 0/1/2; only general cylinder markings are visible.
Photos show physical wear but do not confirm pressure test status, valve condition, or leak-free performance.
No clear proof of cylinder certification, inspection date, or condition beyond visible dents/scuffs (photo 0/1/2).

risks.risk: Cannot confirm the cylinder size/weight rating (12.5kg) from the photos; wrong capacity affects value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cylinder body marking where the weight rating (e.g., 12.5kg) is clearly readable, plus the tare/serial line.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unconfirmed foreign-used LPG cylinder (worst case: not verified 12.5kg).

risks.risk: Leak risk / valve integrity not verifiable from photos (dents, valve condition, and seal condition).
risks.proof: A short video of a soapy-water leak test at the valve/regulator connection showing no bubbles, and the cylinder standing upright.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection/leak check (worst case: treat as not proven leak-free).

risks.risk: Pressure test / recertification status unknown; cylinders may be due for retesting.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the inspection/expiry stamp or test date on the cylinder (and any certification markings).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as due/unknown test status (worst case: assume retest may be required).

risks.risk: Regulator/hose/accessories included or not; photos show a valve/regulator on one cylinder but inclusion for all cylinders is unclear.
risks.proof: Photo showing what exactly is included for each cylinder (valve/regulator, hose, cap/cover) laid out and counted.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming minimal/uncertain accessories (worst case: only the cylinder(s) without guaranteed matching regulator/hose).

proof_requests: Close-up, readable photo of the cylinder markings showing the exact weight rating (12.5kg) and tare/serial details.
Clear photo of the inspection/expiry stamp (pressure test date).
Video of a soapy-water leak test at the valve/regulator connection with no bubbles.
Confirm how many cylinders are for sale and whether each includes the same regulator/hose/cap (show items counted).
response.reason: The photos confirm LPG cylinders but do not clearly verify the key pricing driver (12.5kg rating) or safety/condition proof (leak-free and inspection status). Without those, any price would be guesswork.
